        """Execute one synchronous resolved request."""
        plan = _build_execution_plan(request=request)

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router._internal.providers.retry import (
    RetryClassification,
    RetryDecision,
    classify_exception,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class HttpStatusError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status_code: int, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_CLASSIFICATION[revision==1]")
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("exc", "expected_classification", "expected_retryable"),
    [
        (
            HttpStatusError(400, "please retry later"),
            RetryClassification.NON_RETRYABLE,
            False,
        ),
        (
            HttpStatusError(429, "permanent failure occurred"),
            RetryClassification.RETRYABLE,
            True,
        ),
        (
            HttpStatusError(503, "fatal non-retryable error"),
            RetryClassification.RETRYABLE,
            True,
        ),
        (
            ConnectionResetError("connection reset by peer"),
            RetryClassification.RETRYABLE,
            True,
        ),
        (
            ValueError("retry connection reset"),
            RetryClassification.NON_RETRYABLE,
            False,
        ),
    ],
)
def test_retry_classification_uses_status_and_exception_semantics(
    exc: Exception,
    expected_classification: RetryClassification,
    expected_retryable: bool,
) -> None:
    decision: RetryDecision = classify_exception(exc)

    assert decision.classification is expected_classification
    assert decision.retryable is expected_retryable
